systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Industrial DHPH-PUVC Aseptic Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Synergistic Cold Liquid Pasteurizer & Endospore Sterilizer (ASME Section VIII Div 1 / 3-A Sanitary Standards 04-05 & 44-03 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.technology: Triple-Plunger Ceramic Intensifier Pump (100–300 MPa) coupled with High-Intensity Xenon Pulsed UV-C Annular Quartz Reactor (200–280 nm)
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Titanium Grade 5 Interaction Chamber & Electropolished AISI 316L (UNS S31603) with Synthetic Fused Silica Quartz Sleeves (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Dual Hydraulic Pressure Transducers, Quartz Tube Rupture Optical Sensors, Over-Temperature Shunts, and Automated Divert Bypass Loop
systemArchitectures.description: Heavy-duty commercial fluid processing skid engineered for high-throughput cold sterilization of opaque, heat-sensitive beverages including cloudy citrus juices, plant-based dairy alternatives, and liquid eggs. Pairs ultra-high-pressure hydrodynamic shearing with high-peak pulsed UV-C radiation to deliver complete 6-log endospore destruction without cooked off-flavors.

systemArchitectures.name: Sanitary High-Turbulence Annular Thin-Film DHPH-PUVC Reactor
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Thin-Film Aseptic Homogenizer-Photonic Chamber (FDA Juice HACCP 21 CFR § 120 / USDA FSIS 9 CFR § 590)
systemArchitectures.technology: Diamond Micro-Gap Interaction Nozzle with Helical Swirl Vortex Annular Chamber & Dual Submerged Xenon Flash Lamps
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Polycrystalline Diamond (PCD) Orifice Inserts, Electropolished Hastelloy C-22, and High-Purity Suprasil 300 Quartz
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: High-Frequency Photodiode Pulse Monitors, UV Radiometer Interlocks, and Dual Sanitary Divert Valves
systemArchitectures.description: Optimized for viscous emulsions and cloudy nectar purees. Uses helical swirl guides to induce turbulent vortex flow (Re > 5,500) through a 0.35 mm fluid film, ensuring uniform photonic exposure for all microbial cells as they exit the diamond shearing orifice.

systemArchitectures.name: Sanitary Low-Thermal Liquid Whole Egg DHPH-PUVC Pasteurization Unit
systemArchitectures.classification: Non-Thermal Aseptic Liquid Egg & Dairy Pasteurizer (USDA-FSIS 9 CFR 590 / 3-A Sanitary Standard 74-07)
systemArchitectures.technology: Controlled-Cavitation Micro-Channel Shearing Valve with Long-Arc Low-Heat Xenon Pulsed Flash Tube
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Solid AISI 316L Stainless Steel with FDA CFR 21 177.2600 Compliant Perfluoroelastomer (FFKM) Seals
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Thermographic Fluid Exit Scanners, Flash Failure Emergency Divert Relays, and Tri-Clamp CIP/SIP Temperature Interlocks
systemArchitectures.description: Specialized food safety system designed to eliminate Salmonella enteritidis and Bacillus endospores from liquid egg whites and whole eggs without exceeding egg protein coagulation thresholds (T < 52°C), preserving natural foaming, emulsification, and culinary elasticity.

systemArchitectures.name: Cleanroom Modular Pilot DHPH-PUVC Research & Validation Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Pilot Processing & Challenge Testing Platform (ISO Class 5 Cleanroom / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.technology: Precision Micro-Metering Plunger Pump with Variable Orifice Shearing Geometry and Tunable Spectrum Xenon Flash Enclosure
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Solid Grade 5 Titanium Chamber, Sapphire Optical Sight Glasses, and Electropolished 316L (Ra ≤ 0.2 µm)
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Laser Spectrometer Fluid Turbidity Feedback, Arc Discharge Monitoring, and Emergency Pressure Dump Valve
systemArchitectures.description: High-precision validation skid for university pilot plants and food research laboratories establishing non-thermal lethality kinetics (Weibull and Bigelow models) and filing FDA 5-log challenge studies for novel cold-sterilized functional foods.

targetMatrices.name: Cloudy Orange & Tangerine Juice (with High Pulp & Pectin)
targetMatrices.description: Opaque fruit juice with suspended pulp cells and pectin colloidal aggregates. DHPH nanosizes pulp particles from 65 µm to <0.4 µm, decreasing optical attenuation and enabling pulsed UV-C to achieve full inactivation of thermo-acidophilic guaiacol-producing spores.

targetMatrices.name: Liquid Whole Egg & Egg White Emulsion
targetMatrices.targetPathogen: Salmonella enteritidis, Listeria monocytogenes, & Bacillus cereus
targetMatrices.thermalSensitivity: Extreme (Ovalbumin and conalbumin denature and coagulate at 58–62°C)
targetMatrices.description: High-protein, highly turbid egg matrix that coagulates in thermal pasteurizers. DHPH hydrodynamic shearing declusters lipid micelles and exposes bacterial pathogens, allowing microsecond pulsed UV photons to kill Salmonella and spore-formers without curdling proteins.

targetMatrices.name: Barista Oat Milk & Almond Emulsion
targetMatrices.targetPathogen: Bacillus subtilis, Clostridium sporogenes, & Geobacillus stearothermophilus
targetMatrices.thermalSensitivity: Moderate (UHT thermal processing creates heavy burnt cereal notes and Maillard browning)
targetMatrices.description: Starch-lipid-protein colloidal dispersion prone to thermal fouling and burnt cooked notes during conventional UHT. DHPH-PUVC delivers extended ambient shelf life (ESL > 90 days) while maintaining clean oat sweetness and optimal barista frothing performance.

targetMatrices.name: Raw Young Coconut Water & Isotonic Electrolyte Drink
targetMatrices.thermalSensitivity: Extreme (Polyphenol oxidase & peroxidase cause rapid pink/brown discoloration under heat)
targetMatrices.description: Delicate isotonic beverage with natural sugars and enzymes. Heat turns coconut water pinkish-brown and destroys subtle floral aromas. DHPH inactivates oxidative enzymes while pulsed UV sterilizes the fluid at room temperature.

targetMatrices.name: Fresh Bovine Skim Milk & Casein Dispersion
targetMatrices.targetPathogen: Mycobacterium avium subsp. paratuberculosis & Bacillus cereus
targetMatrices.thermalSensitivity: High (Whey β-lactoglobulin denatures and binds κ-casein above 72°C, causing cooked milk flavor)
targetMatrices.description: Sub-micron casein micelle suspension. UHPH shearing disintegrates fat globules and casein clusters while pulsed UV cross-links microbial DNA, achieving extended fresh-taste shelf life without sulfurous off-flavors.

homogenizerNozzles.name: Polycrystalline Diamond (PCD) Micro-Channel Interaction Nozzle
homogenizerNozzles.description: Engineered with opposing micro-jet channels that collide fluid streams at supersonic velocities (>400 m/s). Delivers intense shear and micro-cavitation that declusters particulate shielding and disrupts spore exosporium layers prior to photonic irradiation.

homogenizerNozzles.name: Monolithic Yttria-Stabilized Zirconia (YSZ) Z-Shaped Shearing Valve
homogenizerNozzles.description: Features tortuous micro-channels that subject fluid streamlines to rapid acceleration and deceleration. Highly effective for abrasive fruit seeds and fibrous plant pulps without diamond-level manufacturing costs.

homogenizerNozzles.name: Tungsten Carbide Micro-Orifice Flat Seat Valve
homogenizerNozzles.erosionResistance: Moderate (Prone to micro-pitting under acidic citrus flows)
homogenizerNozzles.description: Traditional high-pressure valve adapted for sub-200 MPa homogenization. Adequate for low-viscosity solutions, but exhibits lower particulate declustering efficiency in heavy egg emulsions.

homogenizerNozzles.name: Conventional Low-Pressure Spring Poppet Valve (Hazardous Control)
homogenizerNozzles.erosionResistance: Poor (Frequent seat wear and particulate bypassing)
homogenizerNozzles.description: Standard dairy homogenizing valve incapable of generating ultra-high shear. Bacterial spore clumps and particulate clusters remain intact (>45 µm), casting optical shadows that prevent pulsed UV sterilization.

puvcReactorGeometries.name: High-Turbulence Annular Quartz Thin-Film Chamber (Gap = 0.35 mm)
puvcReactorGeometries.description: Precision annular jacket surrounding a synthetic Suprasil 300 fused quartz tube. Constrains fluid to an ultra-thin 0.35 mm layer under fully developed turbulent flow, ensuring 100% of bacterial cells pass within the photon absorption penetration boundary.

puvcReactorGeometries.name: Helical Swirl Ribbed Annular Flow Tube (Gap = 0.50 mm)
puvcReactorGeometries.opticalPathUniformity: High (Secondary Dean vortices ensure radial mixing)
puvcReactorGeometries.description: Utilizes internal helical rifling to induce secondary Dean vortices that continuously sweep fluid from the outer boundary wall to the quartz interface, maximizing UV dose uniformity for viscous dairy streams.

puvcReactorGeometries.name: Coaxial Submerged Xenon Flash Reactor (Gap = 1.2 mm)
puvcReactorGeometries.description: Wider flow annulus for moderate throughputs. Operates well in low-absorbance coconut water, but experiences substantial photon attenuation when processing heavy citrus juice or whole egg emulsions.

puvcReactorGeometries.name: Wide-Bore Static Pipe UV Reactor (Hazardous Control)
puvcReactorGeometries.description: Wide pipe geometry fails completely in turbid fluids. 95% of UV energy is absorbed within the outer 0.5 mm, leaving laminar centerline flow completely unsterilized and yielding severe microbial spoilage outbreaks.
